manifest_row.title: EPA pulls scientists out of climate change conference talk

screening.main_topic: The EPA’s cancellation of scientists’ appearances at a conference where they were expected to discuss climate change and its effects on Narragansett Bay.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change is a central subject of the canceled talks, including a panel on its present and future biological implications; the article focuses on whether EPA scientists could present that work.
screening.reason: Although the article is also about agency actions and restrictions on scientists’ speaking appearances, climate research and public discussion of climate change are central to the reported controversy.
